name: ConfigurationTransitionSafety
proposed_predicate: For every newly committed configuration entry except proven constructor bootstrap, require the committing voter configuration to equal its predecessor configuration's complete (I,O), and require supporting majorities of both components. Enter commits under the predecessor simple config; leave commits under the predecessor joint config. Do not skip auto-generated entries because request id is zero; ignore A/L/N only for quorum equality.

note: Preserve predecessor-config safety; do not replace it with the tautology 'the quorum equals whatever configuration the implementation used'.

name: QuorumAccounting
proposed_predicate: Record full C on each actual win/commit, require nonempty I, JointWon(C,yes/matches), and matches subset U(C). Preserve current-term commitment in the core/commit decision observer. Empty O is neutral, never a replacement for a nonempty I.

name: AckPreservation
proposed_predicate: Retain exact captured applied cursor and snapshot/stable endpoint protection. Normally afterHist=beforeHist; only an eligible, successfully admitted automatic leave may yield afterHist=beforeHist concatenated with exactly one V2 leave entry at last+1/currentTerm with causal origin. Preserve all old entries exactly. Check eligibility, quota, outstanding leave and pending barrier independently; merely requiring Covers is too weak.

name: RequestCorrelatedConfigurationEffects
proposed_predicate: Observe every V1/V2 application with complete before/after config, committed entry, original request/batch, version/context and outcome. For valid success require exactly the shared atomic configuration_effect/apply_ops result. Client identity must match the entire ordered batch/context and handoff; bootstrap and automatic leave require explicit provenance. Preserve deterministic per-operation NodeID=0 cancellation without confusing an empty V2 with cancellation. Invalid direct applications obey ConfigurationChangeValidation, not a fabricated successful fold.

name: AutoLeaveProgress
proposed_predicate: Under continuing fair caller, persistence, network and ticks, an eligible surviving voter leader, stable legal configuration, and eventually available quorums of both sides and quota, an AutoLeave joint configuration eventually has its one leave entry proposed, committed and applied, ending with O=N={} and A=FALSE. No further client write may be required as a hidden premise. Retry failed admission and resume after leader change; JointExplicit has no autonomous-exit obligation.
